evidence.quote: We propose a $38 million class fund, paid automatically, plus a $9 million fee-and-expense request subject to court approval.
Class relief and fees were proposed together; there was no separate negotiation of fees after agreement on class relief.

summary: Class counsel raised fee terms in their opening settlement proposals, and the final deal included class relief and fees in a single accepted term sheet. The transcript does not show an explicit tradeoff of lower class relief for higher fees, plaintiff counsel prioritizing firm economics over the class, defense leveraging fee interests, or reverse-auction tactics. The court declaration accurately describes the fee-and-relief negotiation sequence reflected in the transcript.
